description: This file defines a static diagnostic class for a Roslyn analyzer that checks for properties in RPC interfaces within the Orleans project. It includes diagnostic identifiers, message formats, categories, and a method to create diagnostics when the rule is violated.

classes.name: RpcInterfacePropertyDiagnostic
classes.description: A static helper class for defining and creating diagnostics related to RPC interface properties in Orleans.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a diagnostic warning/error when an RPC interface contains a property, violating the rule that RPC interfaces must not contain properties.
